description: This file defines the CustomerGroup controller class for the admin interface of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages customer group operations such as listing, creating, editing, and deleting customer groups, including rendering views and handling HTTP requests.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class handling customer group CRUD operations in the admin backend of OpenCart, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting customer groups.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the customer group management page, set document title, prepare breadcrumbs, and load views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer group list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer group list HTML with pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a customer group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of customer group data, performing permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected customer groups, with permission and dependency checks.
